name: Miso Paste (White)
siboNotes: White miso is well-tolerated in small amounts typical for cooking. The fermentation process reduces potential FODMAP content.
preparationTips: Use sparingly as it's very salty and flavorful
Dissolve in warm water or broth before adding to dishes
Store in refrigerator after opening - keeps for months
Mix with low-FODMAP ingredients like ginger and rice vinegar for marinades
